scripts.build:backend: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.docker:dev:clean: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && docker system prune -f
scripts.docker:dev:install:backend: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm api npm install
scripts.docker:dev:install:frontend: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm client npm install
scripts.docker:dev:shell: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm api sh
scripts.docker:prod:shell: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm api sh
